sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of oveporexton during breastfeeding. Because oveporexton is more than 96% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. If a mother requires oveporexton, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. However, until more safety data become available, an alternate drug may be preferred.
